recent_candidates.author: Andrew Edgecliffe-Johnson
recent_candidates.excerpt: There’s little precedent in US corporate history for the crisis facing Nvidia after reports that Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese “honeytrap” operation . The national security implications of the allegation, the chipmaker’s founder-CEO’s centrality to his company’s growth story, and Nvidia’s pivotal place in the AI ecosystem all mean the fallout is likely to stretch further than other cases of executive infidelity. Nvidia’s board on Sunday announced an independent investigation, but expressed confidence in Huang. In his own statement admitting that he had been unfaithful to his wife, Huang said he remained “fully committed” to the company. Nvidia is, at the time of writing, the world’s second-most valuable company after Apple, with a market capitalization of $4.5 trillion — almost 12% of the Nasdaq 100 index. And no public company has been more important to the AI revolution or its impact on stock markets: The ravenous appetite from hyperscalers such as Amazon and Google for Nvidia’s chips propelled its annual revenue from under $11 billion to more than $130 billion between 2020 and 2025. The most bullish analysts think its sales will hit $1 trillion in 2029. Huang’s personal indiscretions do not change Nvidia’s order book. recent_candidates.excerpt: The News By January 2025, Paulina Mangubat knew the Democratic National Committee needed to change its digital communications approach dramatically. Voters saw the national party as overly invested in outreach tactics of the past, as exemplified by a widely-mocked February 2025 post in which its official X account shared a long, hard-to-read list of Democratic accomplishments. recent_candidates.title: Paraguay's bank collapse hits millions
recent_candidates.author: Brendan Ruberry
recent_candidates.excerpt: Paraguay’s president was removed from office and detained after the country’s largest digital bank melted down, leaving half the populace without access to funds and plunging the country into a political crisis. A youth-friendly banking app, Ueno collapsed amid allegations of insider lending and proximity to the country’s longtime ruling party, which is closely aligned with Washington. The app was credited with expanding access in a region where as many as one in four adults does not have a bank account ; its implosion was a “ kind of tsunami in the end ,” a political scientist said, and puts at stake “the credibility of a country that has spent years trying to establish itself as a stable , reliable destination for international investment,” a regional analyst wrote in Americas Quarterly. — Brendan Ruberry

recent_candidates.title: Eisenkot gets nod to form Israeli government
recent_candidates.author: Brendan Ruberry
recent_candidates.excerpt: Israel’s president tapped Gadi Eisenkot to try to form the country’s next government, kicking off a tortuous negotiating process that could oust long-serving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. While Eisenkot and Netanyahu differ in style and substance , both men reflect the “ monolithically anti-Palestinian stance that dominates Israeli politics,” an International Crisis Group expert told Le Monde. There is also little “real difference” between the two on Iran, an Israeli analyst said, though recent elections in the US and Israel have created further uncertainty around the simmering conflict: President Donald Trump said on Sunday that further US strikes were “ highly unlikely ,” while Iran — which has taken credit for Republicans’ poor midterm showing — said negotiations were paused following the “shock” election result. — Brendan Ruberry

recent_candidates.title: New York City congestion pricing hailed as traffic, pollution drop
recent_candidates.author: Jeronimo Gonzalez
recent_candidates.excerpt: New York City’s congestion pricing system appears to be working as vehicle traffic and pollution drop, and some believe higher tolls could bring yet more progress. Though the plan’s 2025 rollout was controversial — the US transportation secretary called it “ a slap in the face to working-class Americans ” — evidence suggests it is achieving its aims, with some analysts calling for authorities to go further by raising tolls, which have brought in $1 billion, sooner than scheduled. Similar plans in London and Singapore have led to improvements, bringing down the volume of traffic while increasing air quality. “One lesson [from New York City] is pretty clear: If you want less congestion, you need to make the congestion-causers pay ,” a Bloomberg columnist wrote. — Jeronimo Gonzalez

recent_candidates.excerpt: In a week, barring setbacks, my sister will marry a man dying of cancer, in a small church in Akron, Ohio. Elizabeth met George in person six months ago for the first time, after a courtship of six months of talking on the phone (she lives in Pennsylvania; they met online). Their first date ended up in the hospital after my sister noticed that George’s skin was jaundiced; tests revealed that he had pancreatic cancer, which has since become metastatic. The new couple was able to spend the summer together, in relatively good spirits, road-tripping to different clinics to get second, third, and fourth opinions on George’s tumor, but George’s prognosis has not improved; they have not found a treatment that will meaningfully push back the horizon of death. They could let themselves think that pancreatic cancer was misdiagnosed as pancreatitis. They talked about having five kids together. They had a life in mind. recent_candidates.author: THE OBJECTIVE
recent_candidates.excerpt: Un avión en el que viajaba un bebé de pocos meses y que necesitaba asistencia médica rápidamente ha aterrizado de urgencia este domingo en el aeropuerto de Barcelona , donde se ha activado el protocolo para la evacuación en ambulancia del menor. Los controladores aéreos han informado de que la tripulación de un vuelo que cubría la ruta entre Casablanca y Estambul ha pedido desviarse de urgencia al aeropuerto de Barcelona ya que llevaban a bordo a un bebé de apenas unos meses con problemas médicos que requerían atención urgente. Los coordinadores han priorizado entonces el aterrizaje de la nave con una aproximación directa a la pista 24L , la más cercana al mar y la empleada habitualmente para los despegues. Como consecuencia de ello, ha sido necesario parar momentáneamente los despegues y hacer esperar el resto de aterrizajes. Un avión privado con nueve personas a bordo se estrella en una zona residencial de Florida THE OBJECTIVE Cuando la nave ha tomado tierra, el avión ha quedado estacionado en un espacio muy próximo a la salida de pista, donde los servicios médicos han podido actuar de inmediato y realizar la evacuación. Los controladores, que han expresado su deseo de que el pequeño se recupere pronto y bien, han agradecido en las redes el trabajo hecho en este caso por todos los servicios implicados, como el del personal sanitario y las tripulaciones.

recent_candidates.excerpt: “One of the most refined and intriguing examples of self-analysis in world literature.” —Tomas Venclova DIARY WITHOUT VOWELS [ Wat Translated from the Polish by Alissa VallesAlexander Wat was one of the major Polish writers of the twentieth century. He began as a futurist poet with strong ties to the Communist Party before turning to journalism and eventually leaving his native country, spending the remainder of his life in exile. In the early 1960s, Wat was invited by the poet Czesław Miłosz to the University of California, Berkeley, where they embarked on a series of conversations that would become Wat’s autobiography, My Century, published by NYRB Classics in 2003. Following Wat’s death, another manuscript was found among his papers, a text written partly in code and entirely without vowels. It was deciphered by his widow, Ola, who added vowels, and has now been brought to vivid life in English by translator Alissa Valles.Diary Without Vowels, Wat’s final work, is a mixture of diary, painstaking remembrance, and historical and metaphysical digression that offers readers access to Wat’s postwar years. Though the book gives us nothing like a linear picture of Wat’s life, it is nonetheless an essential complement to his autobiography, allowing us to understand the inward struggles of his last decades—his reckoning with the politics of his youth as well as with his changing relationships to Judaism and Christianity. recent_candidates.author: Jeronimo Gonzalez
recent_candidates.excerpt: A top American astrophysicist left the US for the Netherlands, in the latest sign of a brain drain under US President Donald Trump. recent_candidates.title: The cheap plastic drape saving mothers' lives in Nigeria
recent_candidates.author: Leah Quinn
recent_candidates.excerpt: An 80 cent “maternal drape” is saving women’s lives in Kano, Nigeria — the country where more women die in childbirth than anywhere else in the world. The drape measures blood loss during childbirth; once the level passes 300ml, midwives use massage, oxytocin, tranexamic acid, and IV fluids to encourage the uterus to contract. Hadiza Galadanci, an obstetrics and gynecology professor at Bayero University, was initially skeptical that anything could reduce the mortality rate from postpartum hemorrhage — experienced by 10% of women who give birth and the biggest risk to new mothers — when she was approached by researchers . But the drastic reduction in deaths since the drape’s implementation spurred her to persuade Nigeria’s health minister to introduce it as a national standard of care. Suppliers in Kano now produce them for Nigeria and neighboring countries. — Leah Quinn

recent_candidates.title: The Irish Question After Burke
recent_candidates.author: Max Skjönsberg
recent_candidates.excerpt: The history of conservatism and liberalism is bound up with British party politics. We tend to think of the eighteenth-century Whig Party as changing into the nineteenth-century Liberal Party, and the Tory Party into the Conservative Party (still known as the Tories). But the actual history is more complicated. The Conservative Party is officially called the Conservative and Unionist Party, and was formed as a merger between Conservatives and Liberal Unionists in 1912. The Liberal Unionists were a sizeable group of MPs, including Radicals such as John Bright , who broke with Gladstone over the question of Irish Home Rule in 1886. This split spelled the beginning of the end of the Liberal Party—which had united Old Whigs, Radicals, and Peelite Conservatives such as Gladstone—as a dominant force in British politics. In other words, the Irish Question was central to the development of modern party politics and ideologies. The Irish Question revolved around the British government’s response to Irish nationalism in the aftermath of the Acts of Union of 1800, which created a parliamentary union between Great Britain and Ireland, thus ushering in the United Kingdom as a political entity. Il y a d’une part, une fierté nationale très largement majoritaire et remarquablement stable dans le temps : 80 % des Français se déclarent fiers de l’être. recent_candidates.author: THE OBJECTIVE
recent_candidates.excerpt: Al menos 16 personas han muerto y otra decena han resultado heridas este lunes por una explosión en una planta metalúrgica de la ciudad turca de Aliaga, en la provincia de Esmirna, en el oeste del país , según han informado las autoridades del país. La explosión ha tenido lugar al mediodía, aproximadamente, durante una serie de operaciones de fundición de acero en la planta HABAS, desencadenando un incendio que ha afectado a parte de las instalaciones y ha provocado el despliegue del Cuerpo de Bomberos, personal médico y equipos de rescate. Todas las víctimas son trabajadores de la planta. El presidente de Turquía, Recep Tayip Erdogan, ha elevado la cifra de víctimas mortales a 16 y rebajado la de heridos a trece, incluidas dos personas que continúan en estado grave, durante una rueda de prensa en la que ha asegurado que «s e esclarecerá por qué y cómo ocurrió este doloroso suceso que nos ha conmovido a todos, quiénes han sido los negligentes y quiénes los responsables». El PKK anuncia la retirada de sus fuerzas de Turquía THE OBJECTIVE La Fiscalía de Menemen ha abierto una investigación sobre el incidente y cuatro magistrados han sido asignados al caso, según ha indicado por su parte el ministro de Justicia turco, Akin Gurlek, en sus redes sociales.

recent_candidates.title: Feijóo ofrece «orden, seguridad y vivienda» ante el «descontrol y la inseguridad» de Sánchez
recent_candidates.author: Paloma Cervilla
recent_candidates.excerpt: El presidente del Partido Popular , Alberto Núñez Feijóo , ha denunciado en un mitin en Palma de Mallorca ante más de 2.500 personas, junto a la presidenta regional Marga Prohens, el «descontrol migratorio, la inseguridad y la crisis habitacional provocados por Sánchez» y se ha comprometido a ofrecer «orden, seguridad y vivienda». A su juicio, el Gobierno ha convertido la inmigración en un problema de descontrol, ha dejado desprotegidos los barrios y ha generado la mayor crisis de vivienda de la historia de España, Feijóo ha acusado a Sánchez de poner en peligro los servicios públicos, pese a haber contado con más ingresos fiscales, deuda pública y fondos europeos que nunca. «Usted ha sido el mayor peligro para los servicios públicos de nuestro país», insistió. Además, ha subrayado que cada euro robado por el sanchismo es un euro que no ha ido a la seguridad ferroviaria, a construir vivienda o a cubrir plazas de Policía, Guardia Civil y médicos. «La manera de defender los servicios públicos es gestionándolos: aprobar presupuestos, planificar inversiones, mantener infraestructuras, velar por la seguridad y, sobre todo, no robar », recalcó. El líder popular se ha comprometido a recuperar el control de la inmigración y de las fronteras, con un plan específico para proteger la frontera marítima de Baleares, perseguir a las mafias, reforzar los controles, aplicar el Reglamento de Retornos y solicitar a la UE la activación permanente de Frontex en la ruta entre Argelia y Baleares.

recent_candidates.title: Transportes decreta servicios mínimos del 75% para Cercanías en hora punta el 11 de noviembre
recent_candidates.author: THE OBJECTIVE
recent_candidates.excerpt: El Ministerio de Transportes y Movilidad Sostenible ha establecido los servicios mínimos para Renfe de cara a la huelga general convocada para el 11 de noviembre en todo el territorio nacional, incluyendo un 75% en hora punta para el servicio de Cercanías, según ha informado este lunes en un comunicado. El horario punta para Renfe abarca desde las 6 a las 9 horas; de las 13.30 a las 15.30 horas y de las 18.30 a las 20.30 horas. Para el resto de la jornada, los servicios mínimos son un 50%. En los trenes de Media Distancia se ha establecido una media del 65%, mientras que para Alta Velocidad y Larga Distancia, los servicios mínimos decretados son del 73% de los habituales. El audio que demuestra los amaños en ADIF: «Lo tenemos que hacer, viene de arriba» Javier Leal En los trenes de Mercancías, el Ministerio ha decretado un servicio mínimo del 26% respecto a los servicios programados. Cabe recordar que no se trata de la única jornada reivindicativa para Renfe, ya que el Sindicato Español de Maquinistas Ferroviarios (Semaf) mantiene una huelga propia convocada para el martes 10 y el jueves 12 de noviembre.
